proposal.rationale: Conduct pseudobulk differential expression analysis using DESeq2 on Mono C cells aggregated by biological sample (sample_id) to evaluate differences between fake_B and fake_A while controlling for pool, sex, and age.
expected_limitations: High cardinality of the pool covariate relative to sample size may impact model degrees of freedom and statistical power.
Comparisons based on synthetic or null groupings may not reflect meaningful biological divergence.
